title: How to Reset Your SSO Password
body: To reset your Acme SSO password: go to portal.acme.internal/reset, enter your work email, and follow the link sent to that address (valid for 15 minutes). If you don't receive the email within a few minutes, check spam or confirm your email with IT. If you're locked out entirely (e.g., MFA device lost or unreachable), contact the IT helpdesk directly — self-service reset requires access to your existing MFA device or recovery email.
